headline: Italians Return to Saving, but Cut Purchases: What Families Are Giving Up - La Provincia Pavese
summary: Italian families are returning to saving but cutting purchases, with spending intentions at a one-year low. Inflation and lost purchasing power are weighing, mainly on technology, furniture and cars.
why: Household consumption drives a large share of Italian GDP, so weaker spending plans matter for growth and retail and car demand.
